buffer: Exchequer liquid position managed by the DMO: DMO net cash position + cash-management T-bill stock. Monthly proxy = CG net deposits with MFIs, −(ANSZ+ANTB), pinned to the DMR end-March net cash outturn + (total D2.2G stock − debt-financing stock). The forward buffer is on the DMO basis (remit items only) and starts from the FY-to-date DMO-basis level.

other_fin.definition: residual of the identity; itemised in of_* columns
other_fin.forward: NS&I (model chosen on PRE) + remit other financing − Sukuk − secondary-purchase financing

skill_notes: CGNCR model (seasonal, 3y month effects, chosen on PRE) beats same month last year by more than 3% out of sample at: 3m.
Bill model (Δ bills on financing need, chosen on PRE) loses to a flat stock out of sample at: 1m, 12m.
OBR CGNCR ex Network Rail beats the CGNCR model at: 12m (PRE), 6m, 12m (OOS).

Rule: a model replaces the default (OBR / remit CGNCR, flat stock for bills) only if it beats it by more than 3% on PRE at the horizon. Live in-FY YE still closes to the published remit after Budget / revision. Now: CGNCR to March = seasonal, 3y month effects (6m); bills after March = held flat.
Bottom-up CGNCR PRE mean MAE 8.898719751307292 vs production 8.993083002800013 (edge 0.010492870071736368); NO-SHIP.
score_note: Walk-forward monthly origins. PRE = 2012-01..2019-12; OOS = 2022-01+; COVID = any origin whose targets or trailing 12m inputs touch the Covid months. Models are chosen on PRE only; the bill backtest uses realised gilt cash (calendar known). The remit-plan benchmark is scored where a published vintage covers every target month.

money_markets.note: descriptive only; 3m T-bill tender yield − SONIA, monthly means

forward.cgncr_bottomup_reason: PRE edge inside band or worse at >1 horizon

end_march.note: End-March closes inside the identity: forward other_fin = NS&I (model) + remit other items; FY bills are solved so DMO net cash = plan. next_revision_gap_bn = debt-financing bills needed beyond plan = extra bills/gilts at the next remit revision (+ = more financing).

notes: Next-revision gap +£2.2bn (± £19.2bn out-of-sample error): NS&I +£5.6bn, CGNCR −£3.3bn. NS&I at remit: −£3.4bn; CGNCR on the model instead of seasonal, 3y month effects: +£2.2bn.
Assumption: cash-management bills at end-March held at the last FY-end level (£6.8bn); the DMO publishes the split at FY-end only.
Assumption: months after March use forward-plan gilt nominal × realised cash/nominal (£140.9bn gross); no remit is published for them.
Bill path to March is solved so DMO net cash meets the remit's £2.3bn; the solve is spread evenly over the free months; Oct-26 pinned from weekly tenders.
Buffer = DMO net cash + cash-management bills; monthly proxy is CG net deposits with banks (ONS ANSZ + ANTB), pinned to the latest DMR end-March outturn.
Gilt cash = clean price × nominal × index ratio (no accrued). Redemptions net out CRND/DMO holdings; APF-held redemptions are Exchequer cash paid to the Bank, so private net supply adds them back.
Covid months Mar-2020..Mar-2021 are excluded from estimation and scoring.
